title: Laundries.
officialText:
Laundry facilities not installed within an individual dwelling unit or intended for individual family use shall be
equipped with an interceptor with a wire basket or similar device, removable for cleaning, that prevents passage into the drainage sys-
tem of solids ½ inch (12.7 mm) or larger in size, string, rags, buttons or other materials detrimental to the public sewage system.
